Office-document request (Education & Examination; Other). Task as given: I only need one PPT slide modified: only the first slide needs to be modified, and the following three slides are reference materials for modifying the first slide. 1. Fixed content: Keep the three columns under “Intellectual Trajectory” on the first slide visible throughout; do not hide any of them with animations. The images on the first slide and the “Respective Views” content below the images should be hidden using animations. Step-by-step animation sequence 1. Locke: - Click 1: Fade in Locke’s “Respective Views” content. 2. Montesquieu: - Click 1: On the current slide, fade in Montesquieu’s portrait + quotation materials (do not navigate to another slide, and keep the background clean without displaying the original table content). - Click 2: Fade out the materials. - Click 3: Fade in Montesquieu’s “Respective Views” content. 3. Voltaire: - Click 1: On the current slide, fade in Voltaire’s portrait + quotation materials (do not navigate to another slide, and keep the background clean without displaying the original table content). - Click 2: Fade out the materials. - Click 3: Fade in Voltaire’s “Respective Views” content. 4. Rousseau: Same as the previous two. 5. Hume: - Click 1: Fade in Hume’s “Respective Views” content. 6. Adam Smith: - Click 1: Fade in Adam Smith’s “Respective Views” content. 7. Kant: - Click 1: On the current slide, fade in Kant’s portrait + quotation materials [truncated] Input files: 启蒙运动思想解放.pptx. Office-document request (Business Operations; Restructure). Task as given: Turn the following content I sent you into a PPT. Use one slide for each title section, make each level-one heading a section title slide, and place each level-two heading together with its body text. Position level-two headings at the top left of the slide. Include a table of contents slide as well. The title on the opening slide must be “Northern Region Art Paint Sales Growth Plan.” Use SimSun throughout the presentation. (On section title slides, make the text bold, keep it all on one line, and have it fill as much of the line as possible.) Use a green gradient from light to dark for the background throughout the presentation, but do not make the overall color too dark. On body slides, place an orange rectangular border around the text so that the text is enclosed within it; the border must not be so thin that it is difficult to see. Apply different animations to the level-two headings and the body text. Animations on the same slide must play automatically; after moving to a new slide, start its animations with a click. Put the closing section on the final slide. Create the presentation using the template file, and deliver the finished PPT file to me. I. Market Trends and Consumption Upgrading 1.1 Market Expansion Trend In 2026, the art paint market remains in a period of rapid expansion. [truncated] Input files: 模版.pptx.
